title: First real run of the latency/cost benchmark suite, compared against Mem0's July 2026 token-efficiency figures
summary: Run the already-built-but-never-executed `--suite latency` harness and report per-write/per-consolidation token cost in BENCHMARKS.md, using Mem0's July 10 2026 'token-efficient memory algorithm' (LongMemEval 94.4, ~7K tokens/query) as an external comparison point.
description:
PH-6 (EPIC-5) built a `--suite latency` harness in `scripts/run_benchmarks.py` (confirmed present: `--latency-ops` flag, default 50 `remember()`/`search()` calls timed) but BENCHMARKS.md's 'Suite 2 / Suite 3 (latency/cost and isolation under load)' section currently reads only 'Not yet run. Run separately: make benchmark ARGS="--suite latency"' — this SDK has never actually reported a token-cost or latency number for its own write/consolidation/extraction pipeline. Mem0's July 10 2026 blog post ('the token-efficient memory algorithm') reports LongMemEval 94.4, LOCOMO 92.5, and ~7K tokens/query via single-pass extraction — a concrete external figure this SDK's own EPIC-6/EPIC-7 pipeline (Consolidator + Reconciler + IngestResolver + MemoryExtractor, run together as configured in BENCHMARKS.md's Run D) has never been measured against.

Run `scripts/run_benchmarks.py --suite latency` (and, if token-usage instrumentation doesn't already exist on the LLM-calling paths — `MemoryExtractor`, `Consolidator`, `Reconciler` — add minimal token-counting around those calls first, following the existing pattern of wrapping LLM calls in this codebase) against the same Run D configuration (Consolidator + Reconciler + IngestResolver wired in) used for the retrieval-quality suite, and report total/average tokens per `remember()`/`add_messages()` call in a new subsection of BENCHMARKS.md, directly stating the comparison to Mem0's ~7K tokens/query figure with the same caveat discipline the rest of BENCHMARKS.md and ai-agent-platform-competitive-analysis.md already use (different dataset, different model, not an apples-to-apples claim of superiority either way — a measured data point, not a marketing number). Independent of TRU-1/TRU-2/TRU-3/TRU-4.

**Status: Abandoned** — EPIC-13's BM-2 will delete `scripts/run_benchmarks.py` and `benchmarks/latency_cost/run.py`, which are the exact modules this story needs to execute. Running this story now would produce latency/cost numbers against a harness that is being retired in the same planning horizon. The latency and token-cost measurement will be captured properly under EPIC-14 (BM-7 through BM-11) using pytest-benchmark against the new conftest fixtures (BM-3), which will produce statistically sound numbers with warmup, calibration, and outlier rejection rather than the 50-op no-warmup approach. The Mem0 comparison point will be documented in EPIC-19's BENCHMARKS.md rewrite (BM-26/BM-27) once proper measured baselines exist. Abandoned in favour of EPIC-14.

comments.text: Explicitly abandoned to unblock EPIC-13 BM-2. scripts/run_benchmarks.py and benchmarks/latency_cost/run.py will be deleted by BM-2. Proper latency measurement is subsumed by EPIC-14 on the new pytest-benchmark foundation. Abandonment recorded per the cross-epic gate in BM-2's story description.
